e.title: 一份**意大利语**的集体健康险 burning cost 建模项目**：**逐字写明「**模型给出的 burning cost 是每保险年人的**期望技术赔付成本**。**它不是向被保险人收取的最终保费**」**，**并逐条列出还差哪些块才能变成商业保费**；**另一处是它把**小样本**标在了旁边****——**逐字「偏差集中在 18-30 岁的年轻人（A/E 1,17）与少数 75 岁以上者（**A/E 0,86，n=75**）」**；**并逐字声明**数据不可再分发、因此不在仓库里****
e.title_en: An Italian-language burning cost modelling project for collective health insurance that states verbatim that the burning cost the model returns is the expected technical claims cost per insured-year and not the final premium charged to the insured, listing item by item what is still missing before it could become a commercial premium — and that marks the small sample right beside the number, verbatim noting that deviations concentrate among the 18 to 30 year olds at an actual-to-expected ratio of 1.17 and among the few over 75 at 0.86 with n equal to 75, while declaring verbatim that its data cannot be redistributed and is therefore not in the repository
e.title_hk: 一份**意大利語**的集體健康險 burning cost 建模項目**：**逐字寫明「**模型給出的 burning cost 是每保險年人的**期望技術賠付成本**。**它不是向被保險人收取的最終保費**」**，**並逐條列出還差哪些塊才能變成商業保費**；**另一處是它把**小樣本**標在旁邊****——**逐字「偏差集中在 18-30 歲的年輕人（A/E 1,17）與少數 75 歲以上者（**A/E 0,86，n=75**）」**；**並逐字聲明**數據不可再分發、因此不在倉庫裡****
e.summary: 一份**集体健康险的**个体 burning cost（每保险年人的期望赔付成本）**建模项目**（★0、Jupyter Notebook、**意大利语**、仓库体量 6.1 MB）：**它把 burning cost 拆成**频率 × 案均**两个 GLM，**并明确解释为什么不能用单一模型直接建模**（**逐字「75.7% 的被保险人没有产生任何赔付——这一结构确认直接对 burning cost 建模是不合适的，从而支持两阶段做法」**）；**其最值得记的一处是它自己划定了这个数的**身份****——**逐字「**Il burning cost restituito dal modello è il **costo tecnico atteso dei sinistri per anno-uomo**. **Non è il premio finale richiesto all**（原文此处撇号为 U+0027，本词条按站内约定写作 U+2019）**assicurato**: per ottenere un premio commerciale andrebbero aggiunti, tra gli altri, spese, commissioni, imposte, margine di sicurezza, profitto e possibili caricamenti per inflazione sanitaria.」**（**模型给出的 burning cost 是每保险年人的期望技术赔付成本；**它不是向被保险人收取的最终保费**：要得到一个商业保费，还需要加上费用、佣金、税款、安全边际、利润以及可能的医疗通胀附加**）；**而第二处是它把**个体不确定性**写成了一句否定****——**逐字「这个值是一个可观察画像的条件均值。**它不代表单个被保险人的确定成本，也不包含单个画像的置信区间**」**，**并据此说明用法**（**逐字「要用来比较和排序风险画像，**而不是作为最终报价的唯一依据」**）；**第三处是它把**小样本**与数字写在一起**（**逐字「偏差集中在 18-30 岁的年轻人（**A/E 1,17**）与少数 75 岁以上者（**A/E 0,86，n=75**）」**）
e.summary_hk: 一份**集體健康險的**個體 burning cost（每保險年人的期望賠付成本）**建模項目**（★0、Jupyter Notebook、**意大利語**、體量 6.1 MB）：**它把 burning cost 拆成**頻率 × 案均**兩個 GLM，**並明確解釋為什麼不能用單一模型直接建模**（**逐字「75.7% 的被保險人沒有產生任何賠付——這一結構確認直接對 burning cost 建模是不合適的，從而支持兩階段做法」**）；**其最值得記的一處是它自己劃定了這個數的**身份****——**逐字「模型給出的 burning cost 是每保險年人的**期望技術賠付成本**；**它不是向被保險人收取的最終保費**：要得到一個商業保費，還需要加上費用、佣金、稅款、安全邊際、利潤以及可能的醫療通脹附加」**；**而第二處是它把**個體不確定性**寫成了一句否定****——**逐字「這個值是一個可觀察畫像的條件均值。**它不代表單個被保險人的確定成本，也不包含單個畫像的置信區間**」**，**並據此說明用法**（**逐字「要用來比較和排序風險畫像，**而不是作為最終報價的唯一依據」**）**；**第三處是它把**小樣本**與數字寫在一起**（**逐字「偏差集中在 18-30 歲的年輕人（**A/E 1,17**）與少數 75 歲以上者（**A/E 0,86，n=75**）」**）
e.summary_en: An Italian-language project modelling the individual burning cost of a collective health portfolio, 0 stars, a Jupyter repository of 6.1 MB, that splits the burning cost into frequency and severity GLMs and explains why a single model could not be used directly, verbatim noting that 75.7 percent of the insured generate no claim at all and that this structure confirms modelling the burning cost directly would be inappropriate, motivating the two-stage approach. **Its most notable feature is that it assigns the number its own identity**: verbatim, the burning cost the model returns is the expected technical claims cost per insured-year and is not the final premium charged to the insured, since arriving at a commercial premium would additionally require expenses, commission, taxes, a safety margin, profit and possible health-inflation loadings. **The second point writes individual uncertainty as a negative**: verbatim, the value is a conditional mean for an observable profile that does not represent any single insured person’s certain cost and carries no confidence interval for an individual profile, from which the stated use follows, namely comparing and ranking risk profiles rather than serving as the sole basis for a final quote. **The third marks the small sample beside the number**, verbatim reporting that deviations concentrate among the 18 to 30 year olds at 1.17 and among the few over 75 at 0.86 with n equal to 75.
e.body:
**collective-health-burning-cost**（仓库 `3x14pi/health-insurance-pricing`）**是一份集体健康险的**个体 burning cost 建模项目**：**逐字自述为**「**Modello predittivo del burning cost individuale (costo atteso sinistri per anno-uomo) su un portafoglio di assicurazione sanitaria collettiva.**」**（**对集体健康险组合中个体 burning cost——每保险年人的期望赔付成本——的预测模型**）。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 Jupyter Notebook、仓库体量 **6,082 KB**、**创建 2026-07-31**、最后推送 2026-09-06、topics 含 `insurance-pricing`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 推送落在解冻窗口之内**，**⚠️ 创建在窗口之前****）；**README 实测 **13,353 字节，为**意大利语****；**仓库实测共 23 个文件、4 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `reports/` 10、`docs/` 8、`notebooks/` 4，以及 `Calcolatore.xlsx`、`RelazioneFerriAntonio.pdf`、`requirements.txt`**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「反误读：把『这不是那个』写在结论旁边」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「这个数不是保费」写得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它单独用一节讲「怎么读这个 burning cost」，并在这一节里把它**不是什么**讲完**——**逐字为**：**「**Il burning cost restituito dal modello è il **costo tecnico atteso dei sinistri per anno-uomo**. **Non è il premio finale richiesto all**（原文撇号为 ASCII U+0027；本词条按站内既有约定写作 U+2019）**assicurato**: per ottenere un premio commerciale andrebbero aggiunti, tra gli altri, **spese, commissioni, imposte, margine di sicurezza, profitto e possibili caricamenti per inflazione sanitaria**.」**（**模型给出的 burning cost 是每保险年人的期望技术赔付成本；它不是向被保险人收取的最终保费**：要得到一个商业保费，还需要加上**费用、佣金、税款、安全边际、利润以及可能的医疗通胀附加**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「技术期望成本」与「商业保费」并列写在同一句里**，**并**用「不是」直接连接**——**⭐ 即**读者不会把前者当作后者****（**⭐ 本章所收条目里，**这一句的排除清单是**最长的一条：六项具名**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **排除项里有**通胀**（**医疗通胀附加**）**——**⭐ 即**它指出这个数还有一个**时间维度**的缺口**（**⭐ 与同轮 [[motor-pricing-glm]] 的五项排除相比，**这条多了一项会随时间漂移的东西****）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它另起一句否定**个体层面的确定性****——**逐字「**Il valore è una stima media per un profilo osservabile. **Non rappresenta il costo certo del singolo assicurato e non include un intervallo di incertezza individuale.**」**（**这个值是一个可观察画像的条件均值；**它不代表单个被保险人的确定成本，也不包含单个画像的置信区间**）**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它据此给出**用法**（**逐字「**Per questo va usato per confrontare e ordinare i profili di rischio, non come unica base per una quotazione definitiva.**」**——**所以要用来比较和排序风险画像，**而不是作为最终报价的唯一依据**）**——**⭐ 即**「不是这个」之后紧跟「那是哪个」****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它开头就用一节「方法学说明」把预期压低，并点明**三年数据**这一限制**——**逐字为**：**「**Il modello è costruito su un portafoglio osservato per soli tre anni. Le performance riportate descrivono principalmente la capacità di ordinare il rischio attraverso una struttura GLM trasparente e interpretabile; **non costituiscono una garanzia di accuratezza futura**.」**（**模型建立在一个只观察了三年的组合上。所报告的表现在主要描述的是**通过一个透明且可解释的 GLM 结构对风险排序的能力**；**它们不构成对未来准确性的保证**）**）**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **它把自己的性能指标**重新定义**成「排序能力」而不是「预测准确性」**——**⭐ 即**指标的含义被收窄到它能支撑的范围****；**② ⭐⭐ **「不是对未来准确性的保证」与三年数据**同段出现****（**⭐ 即**限制与数字放在一起**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **同一段还逐条列出**要投入实务还缺什么**（**逐字「更多年份的数据、更宽的时间验证、更新的且能代表组合的数据、稳定性与校准的监控、不确定性的管理，以及为费用、资本、通胀、税款和边际所做的附加」**）**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**小样本**直接写在数字旁边**——**逐字为**：**「I segmenti principali sono ben calibrati (dirigenti 1,03, pensionati 1,01). Gli scostamenti si concentrano sui giovani 18-30 (**A/E 1,17**) e sui pochi 75+ (**A/E 0,86, n=75**), base per eventuali azioni correttive.」**（**主要分段校准良好（管理层 1,03、退休者 1,01）；偏差集中在 18-30 岁的年轻人（**A/E 1,17**）与少数 75 岁以上者（**A/E 0,86，n=75**），**这可以成为后续纠正措施的依据**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「n=75」与「A/E 0,86」写在同一处**——**⭐ 即**一个偏差**带着它自己的样本量**出门****（**⭐ 本章把它与 [[insurance-analytical-case-studies]] 的精度标签并置看待：**一个是「这个数是怎么来的」，**一个是「这个数是几个样本算的」****）；**② ⭐⭐ **它没有把不好的分段藏起来**（**年轻人 1,17 同样被列出，**且**用「可以为后续纠正措施提供依据」收尾**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「好」也被写了具体值**（**管理层 1,03、退休者 1,01**）**。**④ ⭐⭐ **它把**训练／测试是按时间切的**这件事当成方法而非细节**——**逐字为**：**「**Per simulare l**（原文撇号为 ASCII U+0027）**uso reale del modello (prevedere il futuro a partire dal passato), i dati sono divisi nel tempo: train sugli anni di sottoscrizione 1 e 2 (54.456 righe), test sull**（同上）**anno 3 (24.508 righe). **Una divisione casuale avrebbe mescolato gli anni, distorcendo le performance.**」**（**为了模拟模型的真实用法——从过去预测未来——数据**按时间切分**：训练用第 1、2 个承保年度（54,456 行），测试用第 3 年（24,508 行）。**随机切分会把年份混在一起，从而扭曲表现**）**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **切分方式与被检验的用法一致**（**要看「从过去预测未来」，**就必须按时间切**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **它说明了**随机切分错在哪**（**把年份混在一起**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **大额赔付的封顶阈值**只在训练集上计算，**逐字理由为「避免数据泄漏」**——**⭐ 这与第 344 轮的「依据放在看得见的地方」同族**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **它把**数据不可再分发**写在数据一节里，并给出替代**——**逐字为**：**「**I dati provengono da un esercizio di pricing assicurativo su un portafoglio sanitario collettivo e **non sono ridistribuibili**. Il dataset non è quindi **incluso nel repository**.」**；**并逐字给出**替代**（**变量结构记录在 `reports/dizionario_feature.csv`，**数据质量检查的细节在 `reports/appendice_data_quality.md`**）**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「不可再分发」与「所以不在仓库里」是两句**（**⭐ 即**它说明了**为什么**数据不在，**而不是让读者去猜**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它把能公开的都公开了**（**变量字典与质量附录**）——**⭐ 即**数据不能给，**但**数据的**结构**与**清洗过程**可以给**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **它有一个**实测可访问的线上计算器**，且用了**一份公开副本**的系数**：**逐字说明该静态页面可以在浏览器里直接输入画像并看到频率／案均／burning cost 的估计**，**「无需安装服务器或暴露机密数据」**；**并逐字说明**这一演示使用 `docs/coefficienti_modelli.csv` 这份**公开副本**，**而完整报告仍在 `reports/coefficienti_modelli.csv`****——**⭐ 实测该地址一次匿名 HTTPS 请求返回 **HTTP 200、7,340 字节****（**⭐ 本条是本章所收条目里少数**线上地址确实应答**的一条**）**；**该系数**双份存放**的做法**本词条记为**值得学的一处**（**演示只带公开副本**）。**⑦ ⭐ 其余可核实细节**：**① **数据规模逐字给出**（**约 79,000 条「被保险人-年」记录、3 个承保年度、约 40,000 笔赔付**）**；**② **质量检查逐条给出**（**无缺失、无重复**；**暴露度为 0 的 36 行被排除**；**暴露度大于 1 的 8 行被截断到 1**；**52 笔「孤儿」赔付因在被保险人表中无对应而被排除**；**大额赔付按 99.5 百分位封顶**）**；**③ **为什么用两阶段**被逐字说明（**75.7% 的被保险人没有产生任何赔付**，**故直接对 burning cost 建模不合适**）**；**④ **模型结果**（**Gini 0,46，自举 95% 区间 [0,44 ; 0,47]；A/E 1,04**）**；**⑤ **主要费率因子逐条给出**（**退休者频率 3,4×／案均 1,2×；管理层 2,1×／1,3×；合格职员 1,9×／1,2×；75 岁以上 1,8×／1,1×**）**；**⑥ **局限一节共八条**，**含**核内相关性**（**逐字建议用混合效应模型 GLMM**）、**GLM 的线性**（**逐字建议用 LightGBM 作为挑战者并配 SHAP**）、**行业变量只是近似职业风险**（**逐字提到可用某个国家的工伤保险费率数据改进**）**；**⑦ **序列化模型不入版本库**（**逐字「序列化的模型没有纳入版本管理：它们通过运行 NB03 重新生成」**）**；**⑧ **作者署名并给出两个链接**（**Antonio Ferri**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[burning-cost-examples]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[glmmisrep]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[motor-pricing-glm]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测根目录 `LICENSE` 不存在（**raw 探测 HTTP 404**）、**README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出本条有一个**具体的权利问题**：**它明确说数据不可再分发，**而**代码自身的许可未作声明****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其数据能否公开——**未查任何协议**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 Python 依赖、未打开 `Calcolatore.xlsx`、未跑三个 notebook、未打开那份 PDF、未打开任何 PNG、未读 `reports/` 下任何 CSV**；**故**本词条**不主张**其 Gini、A/E、其系数或其所报费率因子**已被复现**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的**逐字陈述**、**其线上演示地址的一次实测应答**，**与**经 tree 接口实测的文件清单****。**③ ⚠️ **未读其 notebook 内容****（**⭐ 即**未核对**两阶段 GLM 是否确实按所述实现、**封顶阈值**是否确实只在训练集上计算、**以及**那份公开系数副本是否与完整报告一致****）。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其数据来源、规模与清洗结果**（**⭐ 其数据不在仓库里，**故**本词条**无法核对其任何一条观察值**）。**⑤ ⭐ ⭐ **一处**语言与可读性**的如实说明**：**其 README **13,353 字节全部为意大利语**，**其完整报告是一份意大利语 PDF**，**线上计算器与列名亦为意大利语**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**：**本站三语（中／港／英）**不覆盖意大利语读者之外的桥梁作用****；**⚠️ 且**本词条**未提供其术语的对照表**。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**该模型可用于任何真实业务**（**⭐ 其自述已把这一点写在方法学说明里**，**本词条只是把它转述**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0**，**且**未核实作者背景**（**⭐ 其署名与两个链接为 README 自述**）。**⑧ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-07-31）****，**入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-06）**。**⑨ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/3x14pi/health-insurance-pricing` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、topics）；README 13,353 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；根目录 `LICENSE` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（HTTP 404）；**文件清单经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（23 个文件、4 个目录，`truncated` 为 false）**；**其线上计算器地址经一次匿名 HTTPS 请求实测（HTTP 200、7,340 字节）**；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何 notebook 或脚本、未打开任何 Excel、PDF 或图、未读其报告 CSV、未做其他网络观察**。

**collective-health-burning-cost**（倉庫 `3x14pi/health-insurance-pricing`）**是一份集體健康險的**個體 burning cost 建模項目**：**逐字自述為**「**Modello predittivo del burning cost individuale (costo atteso sinistri per anno-uomo) su un portafoglio di assicurazione sanitaria collettiva.**」**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可字段為 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信號一致，見下**）、主語言 Jupyter Notebook、體量 **6,082 KB**、**創建 2026-07-31**、最後推送 2026-09-06、topics 含 `insurance-pricing`**（**⭐ 推送落在解凍窗口之內**，**⚠️ 創建在窗口之前****）；**README 實測 **13,353 位元組，為**意大利語****；**倉庫實測共 23 個文件、4 個目錄**（**經 GitHub API tree 接口實測，`truncated` 為 false；含 `reports/` 10、`docs/` 8、`notebooks/` 4，以及 `Calcolatore.xlsx`、`RelazioneFerriAntonio.pdf`、`requirements.txt`**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「反誤讀：把『這不是那個』寫在結論旁邊」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**把「這個數不是保費」寫得最完整的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它單獨用一節講「怎麼讀這個 burning cost」，並在這一節裡把它**不是什麼**講完**——**逐字「**Il burning cost restituito dal modello è il **costo tecnico atteso dei sinistri per anno-uomo**. **Non è il premio finale richiesto all**（原文撇號為 ASCII U+0027；本詞條按站內既有約定寫作 U+2019）**assicurato**: per ottenere un premio commerciale andrebbero aggiunti, tra gli altri, **spese, commissioni, imposte, margine di sicurezza, profitto e possibili caricamenti per inflazione sanitaria**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐把「技術期望成本」與「商業保費」並列在同一句裡，並用「不是」直接連接**（本章所收條目裡**排除清單最長的一條：六項具名**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐排除項裡有**通脹**（醫療通脹附加——指出這個數還有一個**時間維度**的缺口）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐它另起一句否定**個體層面的確定性****（逐字「這是一個可觀察畫像的條件均值。**它不代表單個被保險人的確定成本，也不包含單個畫像的置信區間**」）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐它據此給出**用法**（逐字「要用來比較和排序風險畫像，而不是作為最終報價的唯一依據」——**「不是這個」之後緊跟「那是哪個」**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它開頭就用一節「方法學說明」把預期壓低，並點明**三年數據**這一限制**——**逐字「**Il modello è costruito su un portafoglio osservato per soli tre anni. Le performance riportate descrivono principalmente la capacità di ordinare il rischio attraverso una struttura GLM trasparente e interpretabile; **non costituiscono una garanzia di accuratezza futura**.」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐把性能指標**重新定義**成「排序能力」而非「預測準確性」**；**② ⭐⭐「不是對未來準確性的保證」與三年數據**同段出現**；**③ ⭐⭐同段逐條列出**要投入實務還缺什麼**（更多年份、更寬的時間驗證、更新且能代表組合的數據、穩定性與校準的監控、不確定性的管理，以及為費用、資本、通脹、稅款和邊際所做的附加）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**小樣本**直接寫在數字旁邊**——**逐字「I segmenti principali sono ben calibrati (dirigenti 1,03, pensionati 1,01). Gli scostamenti si concentrano sui giovani 18-30 (**A/E 1,17**) e sui pochi 75+ (**A/E 0,86, n=75**), base per eventuali azioni correttive.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「n=75」與「A/E 0,86」寫在同一處**（**一個偏差帶著它自己的樣本量出門**）；**② ⭐⭐它沒有把不好的分段藏起來**（年輕人 1,17 同樣列出，並以「可以為後續糾正措施提供依據」收尾）；**③ ⭐⭐「好」也被寫了具體值**（管理層 1,03、退休者 1,01）。**④ ⭐⭐ **它把**訓練／測試按時間切分**當成方法而非細節**——**逐字「**Per simulare l**（原文撇號為 ASCII U+0027）**uso reale del modello (prevedere il futuro a partire dal passato), i dati sono divisi nel tempo: train sugli anni di sottoscrizione 1 e 2 (54.456 righe), test sull**（同上）**anno 3 (24.508 righe). **Una divisione casuale avrebbe mescolato gli anni, distorcendo le performance.**」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐切分方式與被檢驗的用法一致**；**② ⭐⭐說明了**隨機切分錯在哪**（把年份混在一起）；**③ ⭐⭐大額賠付的封頂閾值**只在訓練集上計算，逐字理由為「避免數據洩漏」。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **它把**數據不可再分發**寫在數據一節裡，並給出替代**——**逐字「**I dati provengono da un esercizio di pricing assicurativo su un portafoglio sanitario collettivo e **non sono ridistribuibili**. Il dataset non è quindi **incluso nel repository**.」**，並逐字給出替代（變量結構記錄在 `reports/dizionario_feature.csv`，數據質量檢查細節在 `reports/appendice_data_quality.md`）**兩處**：**① ⭐⭐「不可再分發」與「所以不在倉庫裡」是兩句**（說明了**為什麼**數據不在，而不是讓讀者去猜）；**② ⭐⭐它把能公開的都公開了**（數據不能給，**但數據的結構與清洗過程可以給**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **它有一個**實測可訪問的線上計算器**，且用了**一份公開副本**的係數**：逐字說明該靜態頁面可在瀏覽器裡直接輸入畫像並看到頻率／案均／burning cost 的估計，「無需安裝伺服器或暴露機密數據」；並逐字說明這一演示使用 `docs/coefficienti_modelli.csv` 這份**公開副本**，而完整報告仍在 `reports/coefficienti_modelli.csv`——**⭐ 實測該地址一次匿名 HTTPS 請求返回 **HTTP 200、7,340 位元組****（⭐ 本章所收條目裡少數**線上地址確實應答**的一條）；⭐ 該係數**雙份存放**的做法本詞條記為**值得學的一處**。**⑦ ⭐ 其餘**：數據規模逐字給出（約 79,000 條「被保險人-年」記錄、3 個承保年度、約 40,000 筆賠付）；質量檢查逐條給出（無缺失、無重複；暴露度為 0 的 36 行被排除；暴露度大於 1 的 8 行被截斷到 1；**52 筆孤兒賠付**因在被保險人表中無對應而被排除；大額賠付按 99.5 百分位封頂）；為什麼用兩階段被逐字說明（**75.7% 的被保險人沒有產生任何賠付**，故直接對 burning cost 建模不合適）；模型結果（**Gini 0,46，自舉 95% 區間 [0,44 ; 0,47]；A/E 1,04**）；主要費率因子逐條給出（退休者 3,4×／1,2×；管理層 2,1×／1,3×；合格職員 1,9×／1,2×；75 歲以上 1,8×／1,1×）；局限一節共八條（含核內相關性逐字建議用 GLMM、GLM 的線性逐字建議用 LightGBM 作為挑戰者並配 SHAP、行業變量只是近似職業風險）；序列化模型不入版本庫（逐字「序列化的模型沒有納入版本管理：它們通過運行 NB03 重新生成」）；作者署名並給出兩個鏈接（Antonio Ferri）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[burning-cost-examples]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[glmmisrep]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[motor-pricing-glm]] 並讀**。

**collective-health-burning-cost** (repository `3x14pi/health-insurance-pricing`) **is a project modelling the individual burning cost of a collective health portfolio**, describing itself verbatim as a predictive model of the individual burning cost, the expected claims cost per insured-year, on a collective health insurance portfolio. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language Jupyter Notebook, a 6,082 KB repository, created 2026-07-31, last pushed 2026-09-06, with topics including insurance pricing** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **the push falls inside the thaw window**, ⚠️ **while creation predates it**); **the README measures 13,353 bytes and is in **Italian****; **the repository measures 23 files and 4 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, including ten report files, eight documentation files, four notebooks and a spreadsheet calculator, a report PDF and a requirements file. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **anti-misreading**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it writes out what the number is not most completely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It devotes a section to how to read the burning cost and finishes what it is not inside that section** — verbatim, the burning cost the model returns is the expected technical claims cost per insured-year **and is not the final premium charged to the insured**, since arriving at a commercial premium would additionally require expenses, commission, taxes, a safety margin, profit and possible health-inflation loadings (the original uses an ASCII apostrophe, rendered here as a typographic one per site convention) ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **technical expected cost and commercial premium are placed side by side in one sentence joined by the word not, so a reader cannot take the first for the second**, ⭐ **with six named exclusions, the longest such list in this chapter**; ⭐⭐⭐ **inflation is among the exclusions**, ⭐ **which this entry notes adds a time dimension to the gap, one item more than the motor pricing entry of the same round carries**; ⭐⭐⭐ **a separate sentence denies certainty at the individual level**, verbatim that the value is a conditional mean for an observable profile which does not represent any single insured person’s certain cost and includes no confidence interval for an individual profile; **and ⭐⭐⭐ the stated use follows immediately**, verbatim that it should be used to compare and rank risk profiles and not as the sole basis for a final quote, ⭐ **so what it is not is followed directly by what it is for**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It opens with a methodological note that lowers expectations and names the three-year limit** — verbatim that the model is built on a portfolio observed for only three years, that the reported performance mainly describes the ability to rank risk through a transparent and interpretable GLM structure, **and that it constitutes no guarantee of future accuracy** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **its own performance metric is redefined as ranking ability rather than predictive accuracy, narrowing what the metric is claimed to support**; ⭐⭐ **the denial of future accuracy sits in the same paragraph as the three-year figure**; **and ⭐⭐ that paragraph lists item by item what operational use would still require**, from more years of data and wider temporal validation through stability and calibration monitoring to explicit loadings for expenses, capital, inflation, taxes and margin. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It writes the small sample directly beside the number** — verbatim that the main segments are well calibrated at 1.03 for managers and 1.01 for pensioners, that deviations concentrate among the 18 to 30 year olds at 1.17 and among the few over 75 at 0.86 **with n equal to 75**, and that this is a basis for possible corrective action ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the sample size travels out with the deviation, since the entry treats it as the companion question to how a number was produced, namely how many observations produced it**; ⭐⭐ **the poor segment is not hidden**, the young-adult figure being listed too and closed with a note that it can inform corrective action; **and ⭐⭐ the good segments are also given concrete values**. **④ ⭐⭐ It treats the temporal split as method rather than detail** — verbatim that to simulate the model’s real use, predicting the future from the past, the data are split **in time**, training on subscription years one and two with 54,456 rows and testing on year three with 24,508 rows, because a random split would have mixed the years and distorted performance ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the split matches the use being tested**; ⭐⭐ **it explains what a random split would get wrong**; **and ⭐⭐ the capping threshold for large claims is computed only on the training set, with the stated reason being to avoid data leakage**, ⭐ **the same family as round 344’s basis kept where it can be seen**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ It puts non-redistributable data in the data section and supplies a substitute** — verbatim that the data come from an insurance pricing exercise on a collective health portfolio and **are not redistributable**, so the dataset is **not included in the repository**, with the variable schema documented in one report file and the quality checks in another ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **not redistributable and therefore not in the repository are two separate statements, so the reader is told why the data is absent rather than left to guess**; **and ⭐⭐ everything that can be published is published, the data being unavailable while its structure and cleaning process are available**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ It has a measurably reachable online calculator that uses a public copy of the coefficients** — the README states verbatim that the static page lets a user enter a profile and see estimated frequency, severity and burning cost directly in the browser **without installing a server or exposing confidential data**, and that the demo uses a public copy of the coefficients while the complete report remains in a separate file — ⭐ **an anonymous HTTPS request to that address measured return 200 with 7,340 bytes**, ⭐ **among the few entries in this chapter whose live address actually answers**, and the entry records the two-copy arrangement as worth copying, the demo carrying only the public copy. **⑦ ⭐ Other details**: **data scale is given verbatim**, about 79,000 insured-year records over three subscription years linked to about 40,000 claims; **quality checks are listed**, no missing or duplicate values, thirty-six rows with zero exposure excluded, eight rows with exposure above one capped at one, **fifty-two orphan claims excluded** for having no match in the insured table, and large claims capped at the 99.5th percentile; **the two-stage motivation is stated verbatim**, 75.7 percent of the insured generating no claim at all; **model results are given**, a Gini of 0.46 with a bootstrap interval of [0.44, 0.47] and an actual-to-expected ratio of 1.04; **the main rating factors are listed**, pensioners at 3.4 and 1.2, managers at 2.1 and 1.3, qualified employees at 1.9 and 1.2 and the over-75s at 1.8 and 1.1; **the limitations section has eight items including intra-household correlation with a verbatim suggestion of a mixed-effects model, GLM linearity with a verbatim suggestion of a gradient-boosted challenger with SHAP, and the sector variable only approximating occupational risk**;
